record.question: Z a government employee is facing trial for having forged several Tribal Certificates. A print out of one of the Tribal Certificates Z had forged was taken from the computer used by him. The said document would be admissible in evidence:
options: Only if the computer containing the information is produced in court.
If the person who executed printing of the document from the source is examined.
Provided the document is accompanied by a S.65-B certificate.
If there is a S.65-B certificate which is corroborated by other evidence.
